text:
【羽球故事】印尼男雙 Leo Rolly CARNANDO／Daniel MARTHIN 拿下 2026 亞運男雙金牌。

他們曾經一起打到世界第九。2024 年兩人拆夥，各自換了搭檔。

2026 年 5 月重新組隊時，排名只剩第一百五十七。

重組後第一站泰國公開賽，他們就拿下冠軍。

input.query: SELECT p.pairing_id,p.player_a_id,p.player_b_id,a.name_display,b.name_display,(SELECT min(week_date)||'/'||max(week_date)||' best '||min(rank) FROM ranking_snapshot r WHERE r.pairing_id=p.pairing_id) FROM pairing p JOIN player a ON a.player_id=p.player_a_id JOIN player b ON b.player_id=p.player_b_id WHERE (a.name_display LIKE '%CARNANDO%' AND b.name_display LIKE '%MARTHIN%') OR (b.name_display LIKE '%CARNANDO%' AND a.name_display LIKE '%MARTHIN%')

SELECT t.tournament_id,t.name,t.level,t.start_date,tr.round_reached,(SELECT week_date||' #'||rank FROM ranking_snapshot r WHERE r.pairing_id=1957 AND r.event='MD' AND r.week_date<t.start_date ORDER BY week_date DESC LIMIT 1) prerank FROM tournament_result tr JOIN tournament t USING(tournament_id) WHERE tr.pairing_id=1957 AND t.start_date>='2024-01-01' ORDER BY t.start_date
SELECT week_date,rank FROM ranking_snapshot WHERE pairing_id=1957 AND event='MD' AND (week_date>='2025-01-01' OR rank IN (9,157)) ORDER BY week_date
